footer: Blurt Diary · data straight from the Blurt blockchain
keyNote: The key stays only in this browser tab.
votesPctHelp: Vote weight chosen by the voter
votesShareHelp: Share of this item's total vote strength (rshares)
votesNote: ≈ is an estimate: the payout split by vote strength. The chain divides author and curator rewards itself.
votesNoStrength: This node did not send the vote strength, so only the vote weight is shown.
wvUnsupported: WhaleVault does not support {c} yet – log in with your posting key.
loginToComment: Log in to comment and vote.
coalWarn: ⚠ Author is on the COAL list (spam / scam / impersonation): {reason}
alreadyVoted: A vote on old content cannot be changed
oldDesc: This content is already paid out, so it can't be voted on directly. We'll post a support comment whose rewards go to the author and vote on that instead.
oldExisting: You already have a fresh support comment under this post. Vote on it to support the author.
oldPh: Add a few words of your own…
rssHelp: Import a post from an RSS or Atom feed (your own blog or site). It lands in the editor, where you can check and change it before publishing.
rssBadUrl: Enter a full feed address starting with https://
rssFooterToggle: Add a source line at the end (a link back to the original)
rssOverwrite: This replaces what is in the editor now. Continue?
rssImported: Imported into the editor – check it and publish.
tagsHelp: Up to 5 tags separated by commas or spaces (a–z, 0–9, hyphen). The first tag is the category of the post.
communityHelp: Enter the community account, e.g. blurt-179874. Leave empty to publish only on your blog. 3% of the rewards then go to the community.
communityInvalid: The community must look like blurt-123456
draftNote: The draft is saved automatically in this browser.
ownerOnly: Only the blog owner can do this. Log in as @{u}.
devTip: Support the app author (1% of the rewards to @{dev})
promoFooter: Add a small "Posted with Blurt Diary" line at the end of new posts
setIntro: Changes are previewed live. Saving publishes a human-readable settings post (@{u}/{p}) with payout disabled.
themeNote: Light and dark themes switch automatically with the reader’s system setting.
catsHelp: A post belongs to a category if it has any of its tags.
howItWorks: How does this work? Read the documentation
panelsHelp: The order here is the order in the sidebar. You can add your own panel with text (Markdown, e.g. links).
chainError: {c}: could not check (node unavailable) – click to retry
versionsHelp: This text was edited on only some of the blockchains. Pick a chain to read its version.
noTargets: Log in to a blockchain where this post exists to write here.
loginOtherChain: Each blockchain has its own login. You can comment where the post exists and you are logged in.
cfgChainsHelp: Your account names on other blockchains (leave empty where you do not publish). Visitors can see them, and mirrored posts are looked up under these names by permlink.
skipNoAccount: {c}: logged in as @{a}, but no account for this blockchain is set in the blog settings (⚙) – skipped.
skipMismatch: {c}: logged in as @{a}, but the blog expects @{b} – skipped.
postPublishedPartial: Published on Blurt. Could not copy to: {fail}. Use the "Send to" button on the post to retry.
uploadPartial: Image uploaded to Blurt, but not to: {fail}
blurtFirst: Log in to Blurt first – it is the main account.
logoutBlurtAll: Logging out of Blurt logs you out of all chains.
rememberLogin: Stay logged in on this device
rememberWarn: Not recommended: the posting key (or login) is saved in this browser and stays after the tab is closed. Anyone using this device, or a browser extension with access to this site, can read it. Prefer WhaleVault, and use this only on a device that is yours.
keyNoteSaved: The key will be saved on this device until you log out.
favEmpty: No followed blogs yet. Open a blog and click the star.
wvRemembered: WhaleVault logins are remembered on this device (no key is stored).
rememberKey: Remember the key on this device
rpcHelp: Choose which node each blockchain talks to. Automatic moves a node that does not answer to the end of the queue and keeps using the one that worked. Blurt keeps a fixed order because not every Blurt node has every API.
rpcBlurtNote: Blurt: a node without the extended API (e.g. rpc.blurt.blog) is skipped for post lists and comments.
feedEmpty: No new posts from the people you follow.
feedLogin: Log in to see the latest posts of the people you follow on Blurt.
statsPartial: history before {d} was not scanned (limit reached)
statsVests: staked rewards converted at today's rate
uiHelp: Optional. Leave everything at the first value to keep the classic look.
archivePartial: Older posts may exist – counted from what is loaded so far
blogrollHelp: Blogs you recommend (Blurt accounts). Shown in the sidebar panel “Recommended blogs” – add that panel under Sidebar panels.
pinnedPh: permlink of one of your posts
pinnedHelp: Shown first on the main list. Takes effect after saving.
followTitle: Follow this blog on Blurt – its posts appear in your Feed
